description.default: From a single partnership to a global education network.

default.title: The Beginning
default.description: Higher Learning Marketers is founded in New York with a focus on connecting local students with trade schools and community colleges.

default.title: First Major Partnership
default.description: Signs exclusive lead generation agreement with Berkeley College, establishing the foundation for long-term institutional partnerships.

default.title: Going National
default.description: Expands partner network to include ECPI University, South University, and Abilene Christian University. Reaches 1 million leads generated.

default.title: International Expansion
default.description: Partners with CDI College in Canada. Platform now serves students across North America with 50+ partner websites.

default.title: 10 Million Leads
default.description: Crosses the 10 million lead milestone. Launches advanced AI matching engine and real-time analytics dashboard for partners.

default.title: Today & Beyond
default.description: Operating in 164 countries with 560+ partner websites. Continuously innovating to connect the next generation of students with their ideal programs.
